section: method: the router
text: Method: the router §2.1, Figure 1, equations The MoE layer's output is a weighted sum of expert outputs, the weights coming from a gating network ( §2.1 , Figure 1 ): G ( x ) = Softmax(TopK( x · W g )), y = Σ i Softmax(Top2( x · W g )) i · SwiGLU i ( x ) ( §2.1 ; TopK sets every logit outside the top K to −∞, so the softmax runs over the kept two only and their weights sum to 1.) Per layer, per token , a linear router W g (4,096 × 8) produces 8 logits; the two largest pick two SwiGLU experts, weighted by a softmax over just those two. "Even though each token only sees two experts, the selected experts can be different at each timestep" (abstract), and at each layer.
